RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's gender composition alone does not constitute evidence of discrimination. In modern broadcasting, hiring panels frequently prioritize specific strategic skill sets—such as digital media expertise—over sheer length of service or seniority. Additionally, a two-week wait for written feedback is standard within public sector administrative timelines and does not indicate foul play.

Raising allegations of gender bias without concrete evidence will appear retaliatory and could severely damage your professional reputation and future prospects at the broadcaster. 

Instead, follow up politely regarding your written feedback. Focus on identifying how the panel evaluated the position's future requirements, which will give you actionable insight into the decision without making unsubstantiated claims.
